## Stage-weighted implicit step: the correction runs with $w_2\Delta t$ under rk3 (`dt_corr`) {#sec-ch07-vic-stage}

### Summary

A stage of @eq-ch07-rk-stage adds $w_2\Delta t\,\mathcal L$. The VIC solves a linear system whose diagonal holds
$I/\Delta t$. Weighting the solved increment by $w_2$ afterwards is not the same as solving with $w_2\Delta t$,
because the operator is not linear in $\Delta t$. So snapy passes $\Delta t_{\mathrm{corr}} = w_2\Delta t$ into
the solve and leaves the explicit tendency at the full step.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Hands the VIC the step $\Delta t_c = w_2^{(s)}\Delta t$ of the current Runge-Kutta stage instead of the
full $\Delta t$, so that the implicit operator matches the increment the stage actually takes; @eq-ch07-vic-stage.
**Data.** In: the explicit increment $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}$ of the stage at every cell of the column, in
the solved variables $(\rho, \rho v_1, E)$ ($N=3$) or $(\rho, \rho v_1, \rho v_2, \rho v_3, E)$ ($N=5$), in [kg m$^{-3}$], [kg m$^{-2}$ s$^{-1}$] and [J m$^{-3}$] (total-mass basis), and the stage weight $w_2^{(s)}$ [-] of the integrator. Out: $\Delta t_c$ [s] handed
to the solve, one per stage, and the solved increment $\boldsymbol\delta$ per cell, same units. Check cases: rk1,
rk2, rk3, rk3s4 on a stiff mode $z = 10^8$ and on $z$ from $10^{-3}$ to $10^8$.
**Placement.** Every stage with a VIC, after the explicit increment.
**Activation.** None; it applies when the integrator has three stages (`rk3`).
**Guarantee / limits.** The order is not changed by the weighting; the correction is a linearised backward Euler.
**Evidence.** Test: at every rk3 stage the column's mechanical energy closes with the weighted step,
{{< code tests/test_forcing.cpp forcing.implicit_gravity_work_holds_under_rk3_stage_weighting >}} (and a CUDA twin;
$10^{-9}$ absolute); not run at the pin. Check: `python3 src/snapy_report/ch07/vic_stage_check.py`, output `vic_stage_check.out` lines `[C1]`–`[C4]`; the committed output prints PASS and the measured value of each claim, not the threshold it is held to, so the thresholds are **missing evidence** in the output; the check ports the code at the pin.
:::

A stage of @eq-ch07-rk-stage adds $w_2\Delta t\,\mathcal L$. The VIC solves a linear system whose diagonal holds
$I/\Delta t$. Weighting the solved increment by $w_2$ afterwards is not the same as solving with $w_2\Delta t$,
because the operator is not linear in $\Delta t$. So snapy passes $\Delta t_c = w_2\Delta t$ into
the solve and leaves the explicit tendency at the full step.

### Derivation

With $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)} = \Delta t\,\mathcal L$ the explicit increment and $J$ the operator of @eq-ch07-vic-blocks
without its $I/\Delta t$, the solve of @sec-ch07-vic-sweep returns
$\boldsymbol\delta = (I + \Delta t_cJ)^{-1}\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}$, and the stage adds $w_2\boldsymbol\delta$. With
$\Delta t_c = w_2\Delta t$,

$$
w_2\,(I + w_2\Delta t\,J)^{-1}\,\Delta t\,\mathcal L = (I + w_2\Delta t\,J)^{-1}\,w_2\Delta t\,\mathcal L ,
$$ {#eq-ch07-vic-stage}

which is one backward-Euler-linearised step of the stage's own length $w_2\Delta t$. The two sides agree to
$5\times10^{-16}$ in the check [check `src/snapy_report/ch07/vic_stage_check.py`, output `vic_stage_check.out`,
`[C1]`]. The factors per stage are 1, 1/4, 2/3 for rk3. Every other integrator keeps the full step (`[C2]`).

On a stiff decay $u' = -\lambda u$ handled entirely by the correction, rk3 damps a mode with
$z = \lambda\Delta t \to \infty$ to $1/12$ per step with the weighting and to $1/3$ without it (`[C3]`). Every
integrator keeps $|R(z)| \le 1$ on $z\in[10^{-3},10^8]$, and the decay converges at first order (`[C4]`).

In the code, the weighted step of @eq-ch07-vic-stage is `dt_corr` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}).

Grey lines mark the stiff limits $1/12$ and $1/3$."

`MeshBlockImpl::advance_local` publishes the stage index `rk_stage` before each stage ({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::advance_local >}}). The hydro forward pass then scales
only the step handed to the correction, by `wght2` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}). If no stage was
published, a direct caller gets a one-time warning and the full step, through `TORCH_WARN_ONCE`
({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}). The weighted step goes into `_apply_implicit_correction`
({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}). Inside the solve it sets both the $I/\Delta t$ diagonal
of @eq-ch07-vic-blocks and the right-hand side $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}/\Delta t$ of @sec-ch07-vic-sweep. The stage
combination itself is the integrator's, with `wght2` ([`pyharp integrator.cpp:101-122`](https://github.com/chengcli/pyharp/blob/4721715855e937c1e8b218e964c0655f46e56e29/src/integrator/integrator.cpp#L101-L122)).

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
Only the three-stage integrator, rk3, is weighted. rk1, rk2 and rk3s4 run the correction with the full step in
every stage; for rk3 that full-step operator has the stiff limit $1/3$ instead of $1/12$ (`[C3]`).
:::

1. **First order.** The correction is a linearised backward Euler; on the decay the rk3 step with it converges at
   first order (`[C4]`). That the same holds for the other integrators is a hypothesis; the check does not test it.
2. **Direct callers.** A caller of `HydroImpl::forward` outside the stage loop gets the full step, with a warning
   only once per process.
